questions.question: What is the difference between a debit card and a credit card?
questions.option_1: Debit cards have higher interest rates than credit cards.
questions.option_2: Debit cards withdraw money directly from a bank account, while credit cards allow borrowing up to a certain limit.
questions.option_3: Debit cards are used for online transactions, while credit cards are used for in-person purchases.
questions.option_4: Credit cards require a PIN, while debit cards require a signature.
